messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: billing-metering anomaly detected (SEV2) — token-count stair-step in US-EAST emitters. Alerting oncall and metering team. link: https://dash.internal/redwood/alerts/7543210987 :rotating_light:
eric-oncall: on it. digging into dashboards now. any customer reports yet?
james-sre: seeing large discrete jumps every ~10m in emitter-agg, looks like +200k-400k token spikes per window. possibly replay/dup or consumer ack loss. pulling logs.
maria-ops: confirmed, spike aligns with consumer-lag spikes on kafka-consumer-03 (us-east-1). Offset lag jumps around same timestamps.
sara-support: we've got 2 customers flagged with overage emails in the last hour (acct: acme-corp, beta-inc). CS is holding notices but want mitigation ASAP.
alice-ml: quick note — KV-cache eviction logs on serving-04 around the same times, ttl churn was high. could lead to repeated inference replays? investigating correlation.
eric-oncall: next steps: 1) pause emitter retry/backfill for us-east 2) failover consumer to consumer-04 3) notify billing to suppress automated overage emails for affected window.
luis-eng: I can flip emitter -> fallback variant on us-east, command below:
```
# switch emitter route
curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/v1/emitters/us-east/switch -d '{"route":"fallback-v2","dry_run":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
will run in 30s unless someone objects.
james-sre: +1 do it. I'll watch offsets and dedupe counters. adding a quick patch to emitter to disable duplicate-ack path.
maria-ops: pausing retries now: `kafka-consumer-cli pause consumer-group metering-us-east-emit` — paused. consumer-04 failover in progress.
eric-oncall: billing notified to suppress overage notifications for window 2026-03-20T01:00Z - 2026-03-20T02:00Z. Sara, can you confirm suppression?
sara-support: confirmed, suppression in place for the two affected accounts and all accounts hitting >1.5x expected tokens in that window.
alice-ml: quick log excerpt showing repeated submit id+kv keys — looks like client-side retry + missing de-dup key on emitter:
```
INFO 2026-03-20T01:12:15Z emitter-03 Request id=abcd1234 kv_key=usr:789 payload_id=xyz
INFO 2026-03-20T01:12:16Z emitter-03 Request id=abcd1234 kv_key=usr:789 payload_id=xyz
```
if emitter dedupe disabled, that explains stair-step.
luis-eng: switch complete. routing to fallback-v2. emitter instances restarted (rolling).
james-sre: offsets stabilizing, token deltas returning to baseline within 2 windows. monitoring for 15m.
eric-oncall: good. action items: 1) debrief and add emitter-side dedupe check (luis) 2) postmortem to cover billing suppression policy and alert tuning (maria + james) 3) run recon/backfill to reconcile counts and credit customers as needed (billing ops + support).
sara-support: I'll draft customer comms for those two accounts and prepare credits if billing confirms over-charge.
maria-ops: scheduling postmortem for 2026-03-21 16:00 UTC, will include replay of kafka offsets and KV-cache telemetry.
james-sre: leaving a note: add a rate-limit on client retry surface to avoid duplicate payload storms.
alice-ml: FYI, I'll add KV-cache metrics to the metering alert runbook.
eric-oncall: thanks everyone. will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
